description: This Java class handles the processing of down payment commands for loans within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes commands by invoking the loan write platform service to make a down payment, and manages data integrity errors.

classes.name: LoanDownPaymentCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling down payment commands for loans, triggered via a command pattern, and managing related data integrity issues.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a down payment command for a loan, invoking the loan write platform service, and handling data integrity exceptions.
